unified_relative_shape_v2__lgbm.why_ratio_features: Ratio/relative features (e.g. sz_cv = std/mean) are invariant to absolute scale, making them less sensitive to dataset-specific capture hardware, MTU differences, or TCP window sizes. This reduces the ability of a domain classifier to identify the source dataset from the features alone (reduces domain AUC).

sz_all_std.formula: std(all packet sizes in window, ddof=0)

sz_coef_variation.formula: alias of sz_cv (excluded as duplicate in unified_full)

sz_all_std.formula: std(all packet sizes in window, ddof=0)
